Story: Facilitating technical handovers and transitions to internal operational teams. Conducting technical customer onboarding on-site. Mapping out and auditing client infrastructures to evaluate current environments. Responsible for both coordination and technical work within the network team. Drafting documentation and procedures with a strong focus on networking. Onsite implementation of IT equipment and services for European SMEs. Designing and developing both IT and OT environments. Setting up, configuring, and maintaining network equipment (firewalls, switches, etc.). Implementing security enhancements across both IT and OT environments. Integrating VoIP solutions. Performing on-site IT maintenance at customer premises. Performing advanced troubleshooting to resolve complex technical problems. Handling technical escalations and performing urgent on-site repairs. Migrating to the cloud from on-premises environments (with a focus on the Microsoft 365 stack). Managing Microsoft Intune environments. Managing server environments (Windows, Linux). Managing network infrastructure (Layer 1-7). Creating scripts for automation and resolving recurring issues. Monitoring performance and optimizing everything related to network and server infrastructure. Integrating Avaya IP Office systems. Providing internal technical support and guidance to colleagues. Providing 1st, 2nd, and 3rd-line servicedesk support. Managing backups and monitoring systems. Repairing various types of hardware. Proactively updating and maintaining software, hardware, and documentation.
